data.one_liner: A pure Dart implementation of SentencePiece tokenizer supporting BPE and Unigram.
data.what_it_does: It provides a pure Dart implementation of SentencePiece tokenizers supporting BPE (Gemma), Unigram (Llama), and Hugging Face tokenizer.json pipelines. It offers full encoding, decoding, batch processing, and a streaming API.
use_when: You need to tokenize text for LLMs like Llama or Gemma directly in pure Dart or Flutter.
You want compatibility with Hugging Face tokenizer.json pipelines without relying on native bindings.
avoid_when: You are using a non-SentencePiece based tokenizer that requires completely different architectures.
strengths: Pure Dart implementation with zero dependencies, working across all platforms.
Memory efficient with typed arrays and optimized BPE merge operations.
Includes support for Hugging Face tokenizer.json and a real-time text streaming API.
weaknesses: Input text exceeding 500,000 characters throws an ArgumentError to prevent out-of-memory errors.

alternatives.name: llamadart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick llamadart if you need a full Llama model execution environment rather than just a tokenizer.

alternatives.name: tflite_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick tflite_flutter if you are running TensorFlow Lite models and require its specific ecosystem integrations.
